title: PANDORA — ERC404 Integer Underflow Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: Integer underflow bug in the `transferFrom()` implementation of the PANDORA ERC404 token, causing a mismatch between pair reserves and actual balances — WETH drained via a combination of `sync()` and `swap()`
steps: → [1] Extract most PANDORA tokens from the pair (leave only 1)
→ [3] Transfer large amount of PANDORA back to the pair
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] Extract most PANDORA tokens from the pair (leave only 1)
  │
  ├─→ [2] Call pair.sync()
  │         └─ Reserves updated to 1 PANDORA
  │
  ├─→ [3] Transfer large amount of PANDORA back to the pair
  │         └─ Underflow triggered on transferFrom() call
  │
  ├─→ [4] Reserve/actual-balance discrepancy state created
  │
  ├─→ [5] Call pair.swap()
  │         └─ Receive excess WETH by exploiting the discrepancy
  │
  └─→ [6] ~$17K WETH profit
